content.stem: 采用基于风险的方法分配合规资源的主要优势是什么？

options.A: 它降低了合规项目的总体成本
options.B: 它消除了对低风险客户进行定期审计的必要
options.C: 它确保了对高风险领域的关注，同时保持了运营效率
options.D: 它使所有地区的合规流程标准化

content.stem_en: What is the primary advantage of using a risk-based approach in allocating compliance resources?

options_en.A: It reduces the overall cost of compliance programs.
options_en.B: It eliminates the need for periodic audits of low-risk customers.
options_en.C: It ensures focus on high-risk areas while maintaining operational efficiency.
options_en.D: It standardizes compliance processes across all regions.
